insight: Co-founded by Greg Diamos, a creator of the MLPerf benchmark, and Stanford's Sharon Zhou; backed by Andrew Ng and Andrej Karpathy.
name: Lamini
tagline: Enterprise platform to tune and run open LLMs in your own environment.
description: Lamini is an enterprise LLM platform for fine-tuning open models and serving them, designed to run on-prem, in a VPC, or on Lamini's cloud — including on AMD GPUs. It pairs tuning (LoRA/PEFT and memory tuning to reduce hallucinations) with an inference stack and agentic pipelines, accessed via a Python client, REST API, or web UI. Built for teams that need to keep models and data in-house.

modelSupport.notes: Fine-tunes and serves open model families (Llama, Mistral, and others).

edge: One of the few tuning platforms that runs on AMD GPUs and fully inside your own VPC or on-prem, keeping regulated data off third-party clouds.
pros: Runs on-prem or in your own VPC
Supports AMD GPUs, not just NVIDIA
Founded by an MLPerf and ex-NVIDIA team

references.title: Dropbox, Figma CEOs back Lamini, a generative AI platform for enterprises
Lamini raises $25M for its AI development and inference platform
